units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “LEGEND OF THE CENTURY” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: REGULATIONS ON THE “LEGEND OF THE CENTURY” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE “LEGEND OF THE CENTURY” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “LEGEND OF THE CENTURY” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 1. The “Legend of the Century” Prize of the City of Moscow (hereinafter, the Prize) shall be awarded to citizens of the Russian Federation who are statespersons, public figures, workers in science and culture or representatives of other fields and who, over many decades of creative activity in the XX century, achieved unique, internationally recognized results of the highest professional standard and made an outstanding contribution to the political, socioeconomic, scientific, technological and cultural development of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 1

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “LEGEND OF THE CENTURY” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 2. No more than 3 Prizes, each of 1500 thousand roubles, shall be awarded annually.
units.label: Point 2

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “LEGEND OF THE CENTURY” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 3. Candidates nominated for the Prize shall be considered by the commission for awarding the Prize (hereinafter, the commission), established by the Mayor of Moscow.
units.label: Point 3

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “LEGEND OF THE CENTURY” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 4. Candidates shall be nominated for the Prize to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow by collectives of organizations, creative unions and public associations, state authorities and local self-government bodies, and structural subdivisions of the Government of Moscow.
units.label: Point 4

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “LEGEND OF THE CENTURY” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 5. A candidate nominated for the Prize shall not be considered if nominated for other prizes or other awards.
units.label: Point 5

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “LEGEND OF THE CENTURY” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: Candidates shall not be nominated for the Prize posthumously.
units.label: Point 5 · “Candidates shall not be nominated for the Prize posthumously.”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “LEGEND OF THE CENTURY” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 6. Candidates nominated for the Prize shall be discussed in the city’s mass media, as organized by the Press Centre of the Mayor and Government of Moscow. The results of the discussions shall be sent to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow.
units.label: Point 6

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “LEGEND OF THE CENTURY” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 7. After discussing the candidates nominated for the Prize, the commission shall adopt at its meetings a decision on awarding the current year’s Prize, by an open vote and a majority of those present.
units.label: Point 7

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “LEGEND OF THE CENTURY” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 8. On the basis of proposals from the Commission for Awarding the Prize, a Decree of the Mayor of Moscow on awarding the Prize shall be issued.
units.label: Point 8

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “LEGEND OF THE CENTURY” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 9. The Prize shall be paid by the Administrative Affairs Directorate of the Mayor and Government of Moscow on the basis of the Decree of the Mayor of Moscow on awarding the Prize.
units.label: Point 9

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “LEGEND OF THE CENTURY” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 10. A laureate shall not be nominated for the Prize again.
units.label: Point 10

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE “LEGEND OF THE CENTURY” PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.text: 11. Laureates shall be invited by the Government of Moscow to events marking state holidays, City Day and other important occasions.
units.label: Point 11

units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY
units.text: 1. The Prize of the City of Moscow in Ensuring Security (hereinafter, the Prize) shall be awarded for a significant contribution to ensuring the city’s comprehensive security and for creating scientific developments and technologies whose implementation has substantially improved the city’s security.
units.label: Point 1

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY
units.text: 2. Up to 15 Prizes, each of 1000 thousand roubles, shall be awarded annually on the eve of City Day.
units.label: Point 2

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY
units.text: 3. Materials and works shall be submitted for the Prize by collectives of organizations to the Department of Regional Security and Combating Corruption of the City of Moscow (hereinafter, the Department).
units.label: Point 3

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY
units.text: Materials and works shall be accepted by the Department annually from 15.01 to 15.04 of the current year.
units.label: Point 3 · “Materials and works shall be accepted by the Department…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY
units.text: 4. The Prize may be awarded to individuals or to a group of persons (team) for producing a joint work.
units.label: Point 4

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY
units.text: The same candidate or team may not be nominated simultaneously for the Prize for two or more works.
units.label: Point 4 · “The same candidate or team may not be nominated simultaneously…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY
units.text: 5. A team nominated for the Prize must include only those persons whose contribution to the work was decisive.
units.label: Point 5

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY
units.text: The team must not comprise more than ten persons.
units.label: Point 5 · “The team must not comprise more than ten persons.”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY
units.text: 6. Materials and works submitted for the Prize shall not be considered if they have been nominated for other prizes or the candidates have been nominated for other awards.
units.label: Point 6

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY
units.text: 7. Materials and works may be nominated for the Prize only after implementation in practice.
units.label: Point 7

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY
units.text: 8. Materials and works submitted for the Prize shall be considered by the expert council for awarding the Prize attached to the Department (hereinafter, the expert council).
units.label: Point 8

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY
units.text: Where materials or works authored by members of the expert council are submitted for the Prize, those members shall be temporarily excluded from its work.
units.label: Point 8 · “Where materials or works authored by members of the expert…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY
units.text: 9. The materials and works selected by the expert council shall be forwarded to the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow for subsequent submission to the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow (hereinafter, the Commission).
units.label: Point 9

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY
units.text: 10. On the basis of the Commission’s proposals, a Decree of the Mayor of Moscow on awarding the Prizes shall be issued.
units.label: Point 10

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY
units.text: 11. The Prizes shall be paid by the Department on the basis of the Decree of the Mayor of Moscow on awarding the Prize.
units.label: Point 11

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY
units.text: Where the Prize is awarded to a team, its monetary component shall be divided equally among the team members.
units.label: Point 11 · “Where the Prize is awarded to a team, its monetary component…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ENSURING SECURITY
units.text: 12. The Prize shall not be awarded more than once to the same recipient.
units.label: Point 12

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING
units.text: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING
units.text: 1. The Prize of the City of Moscow in Architecture and Urban Planning (hereinafter, the Prize) shall be awarded for developing the most expressive, original and high-quality architectural and urban planning designs for capital construction projects whose implementation will address the tasks of creating a comfortable urban environment and contribute to the future development of the construction industry in the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 1

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING
units.text: 2. Up to 12 Prizes, each of 1000 thousand roubles, shall be awarded annually on the eve of Architects’ Day.
units.label: Point 2

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING
units.text: 3. Architectural and urban planning designs for capital construction projects shall be submitted for the Prize by organizations, public associations, creative unions, authors or teams of authors of architectural and urban planning designs by filing an application for the Prize with the Department of Urban Planning Policy of the City of Moscow, specifying the registration number of the certificate approving the architectural and urban planning design for the capital construction project submitted for the Prize.
units.label: Point 3

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING
units.text: Applications for the Prize shall be accepted by the Department of Urban Planning Policy of the City of Moscow annually from 01.12 of the year preceding the award year until 15.02 of the current year in which the Prize is to be awarded.
units.label: Point 3 · “Applications for the Prize shall be accepted by the Department…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING
units.text: 4. Materials of an architectural and urban planning design for a capital construction project (hereinafter, architectural and urban planning design materials) may be nominated for the Prize if they received a certificate approving the architectural and urban planning design for the capital construction project (hereinafter, the certificate) between 01.01 and 31.12 of the year preceding the award year.
units.label: Point 4

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING
units.text: 5. The Prize may be awarded to an author or a team of authors for developing the most expressive, original and high-quality architectural and urban planning design (jointly developing architectural and urban planning design materials).
units.label: Point 5

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING
units.text: A team of authors whose architectural and urban planning design materials have been nominated for the Prize must include only those authors named in the certificate whose contribution to the work was decisive.
units.label: Point 5 · “A team of authors whose architectural and urban planning design…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING
units.text: A team of authors may not comprise more than three persons.
units.label: Point 5 · “A team of authors may not comprise more than three persons.”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING
units.text: 6. The same author (team of authors) may be nominated simultaneously for the Prize for two or more capital construction projects.
units.label: Point 6

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN PLANNING
units.text: The Prize may not be awarded in the current year to the same author (team of authors) for two or more capital construction projects.
units.label: Point 6 · “The Prize may not be awarded in the current year to the same…”
